# Task P2-17: Frontend — Settings → Soulseek, and the naming template editor with live preview

**Phase:** 2 · **Depends on:** P2-15b (Soulseek settings/status API), P2-14 (naming preview API) · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
The user runs the bundled slskd from Wondarr's own settings: account, listen port, **Share my library** (with the leech warning when turned off), shared folders, upload slots and speed, directories, distributed network; fields fixed by environment variables are shown locked; saving tells whether slskd restarts. A status card shows login, sharing counts and the search budget. In Settings → Library the naming template gets a token helper and a live preview of the resulting path.

## Deliverables
1. `frontend/src/api/soulseek.ts` — `useSoulseekSettings()`, `useUpdateSoulseekSettings()` (PUT; on 400 surfaces `errors`), `useSoulseekStatus()` (refetch every 15 s while the page is open) on the generated types; `useNamingPreview()` (mutation `POST /api/v1/library/{id}/preview`) — put it in `frontend/src/api/profiles.ts` next to the library hooks if that is where they live.
2. `frontend/src/pages/settings/SoulseekSettingsPage.tsx` (+ a **Soulseek** entry in the Settings section list in `SettingsPage.tsx`, route `settings/soulseek`):
   - **Status card**: logged in as `<username>` / not configured / logged out / the login problem (red alert with the text, e.g. the duplicate-login message), slskd version and state, `lastError`, sharing (`directories` folders, `files` files or "Sharing is off"), search budget ("`submittedInWindow`/`maxSearches` searches in the last 4 minutes, `outstanding` in flight; next at <time>").
   - **Form** (Mantine `useForm` or controlled inputs — follow `LibrarySettingsPage.tsx`): username; password (`PasswordInput`, placeholder "•••••••• (set)" when `passwordSet`, empty = keep; a "Clear password" link sends `""`); listen port; Share my library (`Switch`); shared folders (a list of text inputs with add/remove); upload slots; upload speed limit (KiB/s, 0 = unlimited); downloads dir; incomplete dir; distributed network (`Switch`). Fields in `readOnlyFields` are disabled with a lock icon and the tooltip "Set by the environment variable APP__SOULSEEK__…".
   - Turning **Share my library** off shows an inline warning: "Soulseek users often ban peers who share nothing. Downloads may fail or be refused." (still allowed).
   - Save → PUT; server validation errors shown under the form (and per field when the message starts with the field's key, e.g. `soulseek.listen_port:`); success notification "Saved — slskd restarts to apply it" when `restartsSlskd`, else "Saved".
   - Loading and error states.
3. `frontend/src/pages/settings/LibrarySettingsPage.tsx` — the naming template input gets: a **Preview** line under it showing the rendered path for the sample song (`POST …/preview` with `{ template }`, debounced 400 ms while typing; errors from the response shown in red instead of the path); a **Tokens** popover listing the tokens (`{Artist Name}`, `{Album Artist Name}`, `{Album Title}`, `{Release Year}`, `{track:00}`, `{medium:0}`, `{Track Title}`, `{Track ArtistName}`, `{Quality Title}`, `{Artist NameThe}`, `{Artist CleanName}`, `[ ({Release Year})]` optional group) that inserts the clicked token at the cursor; a "Reset to the <layout> preset" button filling the preset template for the selected layout (`{Artist Name} - {Track Title}`, `{Artist Name}/{Artist Name} - {Track Title}`, `{Artist Name}/{Album Title} ({Release Year})/{track:00} - {Track Title}`, `{Album Artist Name}/{Album Title}/{medium:0}{track:00} - {Track Title}`).
4. Tests: `SoulseekSettingsPage.test.tsx` — loads settings and status; a read-only field is disabled; toggling share off shows the warning; save sends only the fields present in the form with the password omitted when untouched and `""` after "Clear password"; a 400 shows the errors; `LibrarySettingsPage.test.tsx` — typing a template calls preview (use fake timers for the debounce) and shows the path; an invalid template shows the error; inserting a token; the preset button.
